basics.name: Anand Bhaskaran
basics.label: AI Agents Solutions Architect · Production Multi-Agent Systems · Finance & Regulated AI · Claude, Python, MCP
basics.summary: AI agents solutions architect who has deployed production agentic systems used by real customers, not demos. Through my practice, Anand Creations, I own the full arc solo: discovery, architecture, build, deploy, optimize, designing for the failure modes of autonomous workflows with human-in-the-loop oversight, evaluation gates, guardrails, and auditability. Finance and regulated fintech is home turf: a compliance-first cross-border tax platform (SwissNRI), an explainable trading-signal system (PulseView), a high-frequency trading team I mentored (Opt Alpha), and product ownership at an investment-research fintech (Obermatt). Built on Claude and Anthropic APIs, Python orchestration, MCP agent coordination, and knowledge-graph and RAG pipelines.

work.name: LumApps
work.summary: Lead developer and architect for production AI agents. Owns architecture, rollout, evaluation, and executive reporting. Reports directly to C-level on outcomes.
highlights: Designed, deployed and scaled production multi-agent systems used daily by real teams, on Python with Claude and OpenAI, using ReAct, self-reflection and hierarchical delegation, with tools coordinated over MCP servers. 2x open rates, 2x approved opportunities; forecast $1M in quarterly revenue.

Built AI Brain, an integration layer that connects 5+ internal and external systems (Salesforce, HubSpot, Pendo, conversation data, product usage) into unified automated workflows via a knowledge-graph and RAG pipeline (Graphiti on Neo4j, event-driven ingest over Pub/Sub).
Owned AI governance in production: evaluation pipelines, conversation-level tracing, tool-selection tuning, cost-per-request instrumentation, and human oversight designed in, not bolted on.

work.name: Beekeeper AG
work.summary: Technical lead operating like a founding engineer. Shipped production AI automation used by millions and grew the engineering team around me.
highlights: Replaced $337K in annual vendor cost with a production LLM automation pipeline built in 6 weeks, with evaluation gates so every output was checked before it shipped. 12K+ assets processed; no external gatekeepers.
Built a GenAI system that integrates Salesforce and live customer data into automated, personalized workflows: the connective tissue between AI and existing systems of record.
Built AI Onboarding Specialist, a production agent that gives every new signup high-touch guided setup at scale, with zero added headcount.

Hired and mentored the AI engineering cohort and shipped a distributed templating engine (reusable frameworks now powering 15% of all platform assets) so teams build safely without a single specialist.

work.name: Tenity

highlights: Mentored Opt Alpha on scaling high-frequency algorithmic trading systems in production: high-stakes, low-latency finance workloads where failure is expensive.
Ran technical due diligence on 20+ startups (architecture, scalability, AI readiness) to inform seed-to-VC investment decisions.

work.name: Obermatt
work.summary: Product owner at an investment-research and company-benchmarking fintech. Bridged finance and engineering to ship scalable financial data products.
highlights: Translated finance and business requirements into technical roadmaps for the investment-analysis platform; improved customer satisfaction and retention.
Directed a remote engineering team, introduced agile (20% productivity gain), and improved CI/CD with Docker (30% faster deployments).

work.name: Dronistics
work.summary: Founding engineer for an autonomous drone delivery system. Built everything from scratch: architecture, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and the algorithms behind 500+ real-world deliveries.
highlights: Shipped an end-to-end platform on AWS with real-time APIs and logistics optimization, from discovery to build to deployment without external consultants. 500+ deliveries, 99.5% safety record, zero incidents.
Built the cloud infrastructure and CI/CD from scratch. Reliability that earned partnerships with Unilever and a showcase at CES Las Vegas.

work.name: EPFL, Laboratory of Intelligent Systems (Robogen)
work.summary: AI/ML research at the frontier of robotics. Built Robogen, an open-source platform for co-evolution of robot morphologies and control systems via genetic algorithms.
highlights: Engineered Robogen and migrated the simulation pipeline to AWS for large-scale parallel runs. Secured AWS Cloud Credits for Research; work featured on the AWS Public Sector Blog.
Foundational AI experience (optimization, search, learning from environment) that informs how I reason about autonomous agent behavior and its failure modes today.

_jobApplication.jobDescription: Payward / Kraken. Remote. AI Agents Solutions Architect for the Global Finance team of a globally regulated crypto exchange (10M+ users, 70+ countries). Primary architect and builder of an AI-native finance operating system across two horizons: deploy production automation now and redesign finance architecture long-term. Areas: assess and map finance operations (close, reconciliations, treasury, reporting, controls validation, audit prep) across NetSuite, BlackLine, Kyriba, Fireblocks, Lukka and build a prioritized automation roadmap; architect the agentic finance platform (how agentic systems interact with financial infrastructure, data pipelines, control and reporting frameworks; simplify the stack; define scalable AI-native target architecture); build and deploy production finance automation using Claude and Anthropic APIs, Python orchestration, n8n or equivalent workflow engines, and MCP or similar agent coordination, integrating internal and external systems into unified automated workflows with human oversight, auditability, and control integrity; own AI governance for Finance in a SOX-regulated environment (guardrails, data classification, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, failure detection, rollback, regulatory compliance, audit-ready documentation, risk-tier classification, named Process Owner); build the foundation for AI-native finance (reusable frameworks, workflow templates, documentation, training finance professionals, metrics/dashboards/ROI, leadership reporting). What you bring: proven track record designing, deploying and scaling agentic AI in production used by others; deep understanding of LLM orchestration, multi-agent design, and failure modes of autonomous workflows in high-stakes environments; strong systems architecture from discovery to design to build to deployment to optimization without external consultants; hands-on with Claude/Anthropic APIs, Python orchestration, n8n or equivalent, MCP; strong finance operations domain knowledge in a regulated environment; SOX-regulated automation experience preserving audit integrity; translate finance/business requirements into technical roadmaps; strong communicator bridging finance, technical and business teams; bias to execution. Nice to have: NetSuite/BlackLine/Kyriba/Fireblocks/Lukka; Head of Product/Engineering at an AI-native company, AI systems architect, or founder/early engineer at an agentic infra company; crypto-native financial infrastructure (digital asset custody, on-chain reconciliation, blockchain accounting); high-velocity or resource-constrained environments; data privacy/information governance/compliance in financial services; vendor management and procurement for finance tech.
_jobApplication.notes: Strong fit on production agentic systems, LLM/multi-agent orchestration, MCP, Claude/Anthropic, human-in-the-loop governance (drafted-not-sent), and regulated finance/fintech (SwissNRI compliance, PulseView + Opt Alpha trading, Obermatt fintech PM). Preferred-only gaps NOT fabricated: crypto-native infra (custody, on-chain reconciliation), n8n specifically, and the named finance stack (NetSuite/BlackLine/Kyriba/Fireblocks/Lukka).
